verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-resource management through the CLI, REST, GraphQL and MCP (create, start, stop and terminate Pods), but no documented bulk or multi-item operation such as acting on many Pods, endpoints or volumes in one call. The single "Batch Inference" marketing line refers to batching inference workloads on Serverless, an adjacent feature rather than bulk operations across many items. Programmatic APIs that a user could script into loops are only developer building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
